ref: ADR-0004 as amended for F-17 (observed #31 d3): a source queue whose context element never occurs in the message is one empty context; ContextFunctions.removeContexts gives a queue of one empty context one empty context (ADR-0004 starts {0, n}); observation #61
note: To observe in PO: removeContexts over an empty input. <Orders/> has no Order and no Line, so Sku in its default context Line is one empty context (F-17). removeContexts keeps one empty context, which mapWithDefault fills with D, so the root's one slot creates one All D, as in fn/mapWithDefault/005 without removeContexts. Since F-17 the input is no longer zero contexts, so this case no longer tells removeContexts apart from a no-op; ContextFunctionsTest does, over {0}.
